subject: Commercial MAP & pricing proposal for OrbitAI - next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orbitai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial MAP & pricing proposal for OrbitAI - next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a pricing proposal (v1) that aligns with the 3-month evaluation you outlined. The MAP includes checkpoints at weeks 2, 6, and 12 tied to capacity commits and signal-based ramp gates.

High-level asks from our side:
- Signature on the MAP to lock timelines
- Agree on the evaluation success metrics (latency & cost per 1k tokens) so we can instrument the checkpoints
- PO or committed spend for tail-floor pricing once you move to full production

Attachment: orbitai-map-pricing-v1.pdf (proposal + MAP)

Next steps: can you review and propose any changes to the checkpoints by Friday? If that works I’ll iterate pricing to include a two-step discount schedule tied to commit/ramp.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orbitai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@orbitai.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & pricing proposal for OrbitAI - next steps

Sergio —

Thanks for sending this over. I reviewed the MAP and the pricing doc at a high level. Two immediate asks from our side:

1) We want the discount schedule to be explicitly tied to a ramp: 0-250k input tokens/month = list price, 250k-1M = 10% discount, >1M = 20% discount; discounts should kick in after the week-6 checkpoint confirms usage trajectory.
2) During the 3-month evaluation we need an evaluation credit/discount for the first month (to offset integration costs).

Can you update the proposal to reflect those points? Also include a short clause about data retention and audit logs for SOC2 review so our security team can sign off quickly.

Cc’ing Dan for transparency — he’ll handle procurement timelines.

Elena
Head of Product | OrbitAI
elena.ruiz@orbitai.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & pricing proposal for OrbitAI - next steps

Sergio / Ben —

Quick internal note on pricing iterations: I like OrbitAI’s suggested tiering. Proposal for v2:
- Pilot credit: one month 50% credit on hosted usage (applies only during evaluation, not to committed capacity)
- Discount tiers: 10% at 250k/mo sustained for 4 consecutive weeks after week-6 checkpoint; 20% at 1M/mo sustained for 4 consecutive weeks after week-12 checkpoint
- Ramp protection: a 2-week buffer after checkpoint to allow for traffic smoothing before discounts activate
- SLA start: discounts apply only after PO is issued and basic SLA is accepted (we should make SLA effective date align with first paid invoice)

Also: Ben — please confirm if we can include the SOC2 audit reports link in the proposal as Elena requested. If yes, I’ll include the link and a short security appendix.

Thanks —
Laura
Director, Commercial Ops
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orbitai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & pricing (v2) — includes evaluation credit + ramp-tied discounts

Hi Elena —

Attached is pricing + MAP v2 per your asks. Key changes from v1:
- Pilot credit: 50% credit for month 1 of the evaluation (applied to hosted usage tokens)
- Discount tiers and activation rules as discussed (10% at 250k/mo sustained, 20% at 1M/mo sustained; activation after checkpoint verification with 2-week buffer)
- Explicit MAP checkpoints added: Week 2 (integration health), Week 6 (usage trajectory & initial performance), Week 12 (ramp & production readiness)
- Security appendix with SOC2 summary and link to audit artifact (link below)

Attachment: orbitai-map-pricing-v2.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ORB-2026-045

As a reminder, to finalize commercial terms we need:
1) Confirmation that the checkpoint success metrics are acceptable (latency < 120ms p95, embedding quality threshold X)
2) A signed MAP or PO indicating committed capacity tier for go-live pricing

If you’re good, I’ll generate an updated DocuSign with the MAP + SOW and route to Dan for PO.

Best —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@orbitai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@orbitai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP & pricing (v2) — includes evaluation credit + ramp-tied discounts

Sergio / team —

Thanks — v2 looks much closer to what we need. We accept the MAP checkpoint structure and the pilot credit. A couple of small items before we sign:

- Please make the SLA effective date one business day after the first paid invoice (we want a brief ramp window before SLA obligations begin).
- Can you shorten the data retention clause to explicit 30-day logs retention for the evaluation period (we’ll request longer retention on production).

If you make those two tweaks I’ll approve and we’ll have Dan trigger the PO next week. Please send the DocuSign and I’ll route internally for signature.

Elena
Head of Product | OrbitAI
